state.name: X
state.description: global position of the centre of gravity, x

state.name: Y
state.description: global position of the centre of gravity, y

state.name: Ux
state.description: body-frame longitudinal velocity at the centre of gravity

state.name: Uy
state.description: body-frame lateral velocity at the centre of gravity

input.name: Fx
input.description: total longitudinal tire force, positive drive, negative brake

vehicle.description: CARLA 0.9.15 vehicle.lincoln.mkz_2020 with its default physics, as Bench2Drive spawns it; actuation tables in mkz2020_actuation.json (scripts/identify_ego.py). The tyre values are the Model 3's, unused by the kinematic urban NMPC.

sources.carla: read from the blueprint's physics control
sources.assumed: not exposed by CARLA; estimate to be confirmed by a test

Izz.note: not used by the kinematic urban NMPC; m (L/2)^2 order of magnitude

a.description: centre of gravity to front axle
a.note: front axle 1.472 m ahead of the actor origin, centre of mass 0.30 m ahead of it

b.description: centre of gravity to rear axle
b.note: rear axle 1.389 m behind the actor origin, plus the centre of mass's 0.30 m

h.note: not used by the kinematic urban NMPC

C_alpha_f.description: front axle cornering stiffness (both tires); value at the static load, the model uses load_table: stiffness against axle normal load [N], PhysX's per-tire curve rest load x lat_stiff_value x s(load / rest load / lat_stiff_max_load), s(x) = 1.5x - 0.5x^3, flat from 3x the rest load (docs/vehicle_parameters.md)

C_alpha_r.description: rear axle cornering stiffness (both tires); value at the static load, the model uses load_table: stiffness against axle normal load [N], PhysX's per-tire curve rest load x lat_stiff_value x s(load / rest load / lat_stiff_max_load), s(x) = 1.5x - 0.5x^3, flat from 3x the rest load (docs/vehicle_parameters.md)

mu.description: tire-road friction coefficient; a scenario variable

drive_front.description: share of drive force on the front axle (four-wheel drive)

brake_front.description: share of brake force on the front axle

F_drive_max.description: peak drive force at the wheels
F_drive_max.note: m x 6.8 m/s^2, the most full throttle gave (scripts/identify_ego.py)

F_brake_max.description: peak brake force at the wheels
F_brake_max.note: m x 7.7 m/s^2, full brake at 10-20 m/s (scripts/identify_ego.py)

P_max.note: full throttle gives about 2.1 m/s^2 at 25 m/s: F 3.6 kN plus drag, times 25 m/s

CdA.note: drag 0.3 x frontal area about 2 m^2

delta_max.description: road-wheel steering angle limit above 120 km/h
delta_max.note: road-wheel angle for steer 1 at 20 m/s (it is 1.1 at 3 m/s): the smaller, so it holds at any speed

delta_rate_max.note: CARLA steers without a rate limit (a 0.15 s lag); this keeps plans smooth

Ux_min.description: slip-angle denominator guard; the model is meant for Ux > 3
